name: rfa-scholarly-writing
description: Helps structure scholarly documents and prepare verified, correctly formatted references and AI-use disclosures.

entry_points.scripts/recommend.py: Recommends citation standard, reporting guideline, and document sections.
entry_points.scripts/render_disclosure.py: Builds AI-use disclosure statements according to venue policies.
entry_points.references/scripts/resolve_metadata.py: Verify a DOI, PMID or title against Crossref, doi.org and NCBI
entry_points.references/scripts/format_reference.py: Formats references and documents with CSL styles using pandoc or citeproc-py.
entry_points.references/scripts/order_references.py: Orders reference lists by citation style family rules.
entry_points.references/scripts/validate_citations.py: Validates consistency between in-text citations and reference entries.
entry_points.references/scripts/check_et_al_rules.py: Checks author-list truncation and et al. rules for citation styles.
entry_points.references/scripts/abbreviate_journal.py: Abbreviate journal titles from the item's short title or a user-supplied list
